This game is actually the worst iteration they have done. They decided that they would add this battle-pass style of system to the game, which is fine for modes like MUT or H2H i guess, but there is no way to turn off the logos from you or your opponents badges. Not to mention that if you are playing franchise, be prepared for it to not work correctly. Your logo appears on the home team no matter what. Firstly, this is immersion breaking, as I would rather see the teams logos down there in the score ticker. Second, its on the home team even when you are away! So for me, it was Cin v Cin because I had my battlepass title set to that. Not only to mention that, they actually went out of their way to say that this is not a bug, but a feature.

DO NOT BUY THIS GAME. I seriously thought I would give Madden a go since I saw it on sale. Save your money, and don't even bother. Do not support future Madden products either.

Reviewing this in 2026, I don't even know if there's any point in reviewing a game that'll soon shutdown but it was very fun, I don't have much of a basis on this game since my first American Football game would me Madden 19 on the Playstation 4.

Being an offline player, I avoid the online content- so I can't give much opinion on that.
Other than that, I do believe it plays, feels, and runs pretty well.
I didn't get any issues upon opening it, nor do I get any sort of lags, stutters or framedrops, the game runs well.
I believe the only issues that I have with this is with the controller, Steam Input absolutely screws up everything up and trying to play via Remote Play is a task more difficult than piloting an airship; but turning that off or playing locally seems to be pretty alright.
Upon opening the game, some sounds were crackling, which I assume was a driver issue so I can't hold that too much on EA.
Other than, I genuinely think it was pretty fine from my perspective, I don't have much of a basis to go off of and it plays like how I would expect it to, it's super fun, AI feels pretty fair, the game is pretty immersive, animations are pretty good.

At the very least, it feels like a decent game for me.

A few bugs but overall the best Madden I have played in years.. possibly ever. Franchise mode is amazing and game play is top notch. I have played every Madden for countless hours since 1995 and this one would be up there and possibly beating out Madden 05 as the best ever. It is very clear EA has put in a lot of work. I can overlook most of the bugs and the only one I find irritating is the create-a-player bug that you cannot edit the play after you create him. I try to change the uniform to short sleeves and it wont even display it. Same with the helmet... it gives me the generic look and I want to change it but not only will it not let me but I cant even view the other helmets. It just shows me the generic look for every helmet. If I select the helmet and/or jersey type I know I want, or select a trait like Big Hitter it wont save it. Not a game breaker just kind of annoying and waiting on a fix or update hasnt happened.

Wish I could still refund it. I was already pretty set on not buying EA but just wanted to play some good football. Will not be buying an EA product ever again. I'd say the graphics are really good, but they are pretty much on par with anything that came out 2018-2020. Nothing impressive. Human facial expressions are pretty bad, animations are various and comprehensive but overly rigid and lack the fluidity and impact of humans.
